Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024)
Description: The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024) set mandatory cybersecurity requirements for Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) and Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) across 4 Main Domains and 24 Subdomains on Microsoft Azure.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-T-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Roles and RACI Matrix
Requirements.Description: In addition to ECC 1-4-1, the Authorizing Official shall identify, document, and approve cybersecurity roles and RACI assignment for all stakeholders of the cloud services.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-T-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Risk Management & Posture
Requirements.Description: Define acceptable risk levels for cloud services, incorporate CST-accredited data classification, and maintain an active cybersecurity risk register for cloud workloads.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-T-1 Continuous Cloud Compliance Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Continuous or real-time compliance monitoring of the CSP and cloud resources with relevant national cybersecurity legislation and contract clauses.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-3 Compliance with Standards, Laws, and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-4-T-1 HR Security & Screening for Sensitive Cloud Access
Requirements.Description: Screening or vetting candidates of personnel with access to sensitive cloud functions (Key Management, Tenancy Administration, Access Control).

Requirements.Name: 2-1-T-1 Cloud Asset Inventory & CMDB Tracking
Requirements.Description: Maintain an automated, accurate inventory of all cloud services and information and technology assets related to the cloud tenancy.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-T-1 Cloud IAM, Session Lockout & Privileged User MFA
Requirements.Description: Lifecycle management of cloud credentials, user credential confidentiality, secure session management/timeout, mandatory MFA for privileged cloud users, and unauthorized access detection threshold.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-T-1 Cloud Community & Tenant Isolation Verification
Requirements.Description: Verify that the CSP isolates community cloud services provided to CSTs (government and CNI entities) from any other cloud computing provided to entities outside scope.

Requirements.Name: 2-4-T-1 Secure Connection Channel with CSP
Requirements.Description: Protect the connection channel with the CSP using secure cryptographic protocols, dedicated private interconnects, and strict VCN firewall rules.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-T-1 Mobile Devices Security & Secure Data Sanitization
Requirements.Description: Data sanitation and secure disposal for end-user devices with access to cloud services.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-T-1 Cloud Data Protection, Exit Strategy & Secure Transfer
Requirements.Description: Exit strategy to ensure secure disposal of data on termination/expiry of contract, and utilizing secure means to export and transfer data and virtual infrastructure.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-T-1 Cryptographic Primitives & In-Transit/At-Rest Encryption
Requirements.Description: Technical mechanisms and cryptographic primitives for strong encryption as per National Cryptographic Standards (NCS-1:2020), and encryption of all data transferred to or from cloud.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-T-1 Cloud Backup, Recovery & Medium Protection
Requirements.Description: Securing access, storage, and transfer of cloud data backups and protecting backup media against tampering, deletion, or unauthorized access.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-T-1 Cloud Vulnerability Assessment & Patch SLA
Requirements.Description: Assessing and remediating vulnerabilities on cloud services at least once every three months, and managing CSP-notified vulnerabilities.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-T-1 Periodic Cloud Penetration Testing
Requirements.Description: Conduct simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing on internet-facing cloud endpoints at least once every six months.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-T-1 Cloud Login & Security Event Logging
Requirements.Description: Activating and collecting login event logs, audit trails, and cybersecurity event logs on all cloud assets for continuous monitoring.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-T-1 Incident Detection, Forensics & Real-Time Reporting
Requirements.Description: Establish incident handling procedures, real-time reporting of cloud security breaches to NCA, and chain of custody support.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-T-1 Cloud Key Management & External Key Storage
Requirements.Description: Ensure well-defined ownership for cryptographic keys, secure data retrieval mechanisms, and external key backup enforcement.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-T-1 Cloud Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (DR)
Requirements.Description: Developing and implementing disaster recovery and business continuity procedures related to cloud computing in a secure manner.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-T-1 Cloud Supply Chain & Third-Party Integration Governance
Requirements.Description: Enforce strict third-party provider risk management, security documentation verification, and In-Kingdom SOC/NOC mandates.
